Congenital narrowing affects renal arteries; intrinsic kidney damage is not required or established as common.

Defining fibular/joint, nail and external-ear abnormalities; intellectual disability is annotated in 80-99%.
Urothelial malignancy arising in prostatic urethral or ductal urothelium; urethra belongs to the urinary axis.

Immune-mediated inflammatory disease of spinal and peripheral joints; uveitis is not consistently present in at least 30%.
Neoplasm of bone or articular cartilage; additional organ involvement is not shared across this umbrella.

Cardiac electrical disorder characterized by early repolarization and ventricular fibrillation.
Isolated congenital cervical skin webbing; associated facial morphology does not establish other organ disease.
Inborn biogenic amine metabolism/transport disorders; neurologic dysfunction affects most patients across neurotransmitter and pyridoxine-related subgroups.
Defining joint instability, bone fragility and abnormal skin connective tissue; blue sclera alone does not impair vision; bruising is not a coagulation disorder.
Neurodevelopmental disease with defining strabismus; hearing loss lacks a clear >=30% frequency. Feeding symptoms and separately diagnosed infections do not add organs.
SETD2-related neurodevelopmental syndrome with intellectual disability and developmental delay; overgrowth alone does not establish skeletal or endocrine damage.
Benign bone-forming neoplasm; occasional sinus obstruction does not establish common airway damage.
Riboflavin transport defect causing motor/cranial neuropathy with characteristic sensorineural deafness; respiratory weakness is neurogenic.
Rhabdomyoblastic soft-tissue malignancy; mucosal sites vary, so no single urinary, airway or gastrointestinal organ applies across the group.
Lysosomal lipid storage with defining neurologic deterioration; hepatic and splenic infiltration with hepatosplenomegaly occurs in most late-infantile cases.
Malignancy of vascular endothelial cells; no particular additional anatomical site defines this histologic subtype.
B-cell lymphoid malignancy requires both blood-cell and lymphoma mechanism axes; mediastinal location does not establish lung involvement.
